messages:
Priya (CSM): Hey team — Atlaswell just flagged that their EU demo next week is already getting rate-limited. They want a short-term lift and an IP allowlist for their proxy so latency stays low for the pilot. Renewal convo with them is scheduled in two weeks; customer health is OK but this is a potential blocker if the demo fails. Can infra/edge help with a temporary QPS bump + CIDR pinning for eu-west?
Atlaswell Ops (customer): Confirming — we'll be running traffic from these ranges during the demo window (Fri 2026-04-02 09:00-13:00 UTC): 203.0.113.0/28, 198.51.100.64/28. We need ~3x the current QPS for the 4-hour window.
Luca (Edge Eng): Got it. Quick clarifying q: are they behind our proxy or direct to the VPC connector? Which model endpoints (text vs embeddings)?
Priya (CSM): They're on Hosted API for text gen endpoints (gpt-variant) via our EU gateway. Using our proxy (regional VPC egress) — CSM confirmed no private deployment.
Jamal (SRE): From infra side, temporary rate bump + CIDR allowlist is fine if we schedule a controlled window and limit duration. Can we do auto-revoke after 6 hours? Also need to ensure no cross-tenant KV cache impacts.
Priya (CSM): Auto-revoke after 6h sounds good — keeps this scoped. Atlaswell, can you confirm the exact UTC window? We'll try to make it as tight as possible.
Atlaswell Ops (customer): Window confirmed: 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC — 13:00 UTC. Please proceed with allowlist and QPS bump x3 for that window only. We'll patch our client to backoff if we see any 429s.
Luca (Edge Eng): Thumbsup. I'll prepare the routing change and the ACL. Snippet I'll apply:
```
route: eu-west-1
allow_cidrs:
  - 203.0.113.0/28
  - 198.51.100.64/28
qps_override: 3x
auto_revoke: 6h
```
Luca (Edge Eng): ETA ~30–45m to stage the change in the staging cluster, then a short validation. Jamal — can you pre-check capacity for the time slot?
Jamal (SRE): Will run a quick capacity sim now and mark any hotspots. If we see contention on the eu-hosted pool, we'll route to eu-fallback-2 (same latency tier) as a fallback.
NetBot: Ticket created: CS-10248 — Atlaswell temporary EU allowlist + QPS bump (owner: Luca). Scheduled window: 2026-04-02 09:00-13:00 UTC. Auto-revoke: 6h after start.
Priya (CSM): Thanks @Luca and @Jamal — I'll add this to the renewal risk notes and email Atlaswell the runbook and rollback plan. Also: reminder to capture feedback after the demo (prompt quality / latency) — that'll feed into Redwood Optimize recommendations for them.
Atlaswell Ops (customer): Appreciated — please share the runbook. We'll have an engineer standing by during the demo.
Luca (Edge Eng): Runbook link (staging): https://internal.redwood/runbooks/cs-10248
Luca (Edge Eng): I'll post final confirmation once the allowlist is applied and validated in staging.
Priya (CSM): Follow-up item: Priya -> renewals to note that delivery of the demo (and this quick ops support) reduces immediate renewal risk but we should follow up with a performance SOW if usage grows.
Jamal (SRE): Capacity checked — eu pool can absorb 3x for 4h with fallback. I'll leave an alarm on the route to auto-notify if queue depth > 60% during the window.
Luca (Edge Eng): Done: staged, validated, and queued for apply. Will apply changes 10m before window to avoid last-minute rush.
Priya (CSM): Amazing — closing loop. I'll post a short after-action thread post-demo with customer feedback and any follow-up config changes. :thumbsup:
